environment.scanners: installed real SQLMap and Nuclei; controlled local Nuclei template
environment.processes: real Server, Scheduler and Python Runtime over mTLS; public API mutations

acceptance.A1: Exact POST/path/query/body/authentication and parameter probing verified at the HTTP target; exact source/settings/operation/preparation provenance, canonical package and receipt verified. Nuclei template ID and separate URL coverage verified.
acceptance.A2: Missing authentication causes no target request; retained unknown/cancelled/failure gaps never become a passing security verdict. Preparation/executor/Runtime tests cover missing path/body, excluded parameters, malformed and truncated output.
acceptance.A3: Pending active-check review prevents Run submission until explicit approval. Ordinary scanner process suite passes including missing binaries, Nuclei, Naabu, SQLMap, ffuf, invalid input, cancellation and publication failure.
acceptance.A4: Lost completed journal acknowledgement causes one dispatched job and one Audit Run. Failed canonical publication and rolled-back collection recover after Server restart without rescanning. Known failures stop at three Audit Runs. Canonical retained packages/report/receipts remain intact after all child Runs are deleted.

commands.command: cd runtime && uv run --frozen pytest -W error tests/test_tool_worker.py tests/test_scan_toolset.py tests/test_scan_http_request.py tests/test_audit_completion_contracts.py
runtime/.venv/bin/ruff check scripts/test-openapi-audit-scan-e2e.py && runtime/.venv/bin/ruff format --check scripts/test-openapi-audit-scan-e2e.py

mandatory_gate: make test-openapi-audit-scan-e2e; empty, missing and skipped process selections are rejected
scope_limit: Supplied-OpenAPI bounded scanning only. Preparation execution, model-generated API quality and independent PoC verification are not delivered by this task.
diagnostic_notes: The first environment check found an incomplete demo SQLMap installation (missing plugins.dbms.cache). Final gates used the existing complete test installation; no scanner or demo files were changed.
The seven-case gate needed a 150-second per-condition allowance for six Stage attempts across three bounded Runs. Final complete gate finished in 247 seconds under the original six-minute limit.
